scope: Qualified UX review opinions from the canonical97-second user video and one-second contact sheets. These are not frame-accurate collision proofs, performance measurements or authorization for unrelated changes.

opinions.observation: The red warning is a generic wolf actor-origin disc; it does not explain the visible mouth path, charge lane or separate pending bite phase.
opinions.opinion: Show a committed charge lane or local mouth-phase footprint that agrees with the actual contact geometry, then clear each resolved phase immediately. The indicator should help the player predict where a dodge is safe.
opinions.qualification: The origin was verified by root from the full27-second frame and code. Earlier low-resolution appearance as a player-origin ring was corrected.

opinions.observation: Repeated stamina warnings cover the central combat area while the player repeatedly tries actions.
opinions.opinion: A persistent disabled/cost state on the action button and a less repetitive warning could clarify that an input was rejected before any attack. This would separate resource failure from a genuine collision miss.
opinions.qualification: Stamina rejection may explain some apparent failed inputs. It does not explain all visible misses, and no stamina balance/input change is proposed here.

opinions.observation: During close front-facing combat, the small warrior is often partly hidden beneath the much larger wolf's muzzle and forequarters.
opinions.opinion: Review camera elevation/near-fight framing or a subtle player visibility cue. The approved model scale should stay fixed; better visibility would help distinguish a real fall, guard, shove and prone maul.
opinions.qualification: This is a readability opinion from the supplied camera view, not evidence that model scaling or animation is incorrect.

opinions.observation: Healing ticks and several damage numbers appear close to the same character overlap.
opinions.opinion: Clearer ownership/placement of hit, block and healing feedback could reduce uncertainty about which action connected. Keep healing/combat balance separate from any cosmetic presentation decision.
opinions.qualification: The sheets establish visual clutter but do not identify every individual damage/heal event.

opinions.observation: BLOCK text/white flash can occur around the same shield action that later performs its outgoing push.
opinions.opinion: A clearer distinction between held guard, successful defensive block and released push would make the narrow outgoing hit moment easier to understand.
opinions.qualification: The existing shield cast blocks before its released push window. A defensive block is not automatically proof that the later push damaged the wolf; real animation/surface tests handle that distinction.
